title: Who Really Built the Pyramids?
paragraphs: The Great Pyramid of Giza was built for King Khufu about 4,500 years ago. It is the largest of the three famous pyramids there. For a long time, many people believed that slaves built it. Films and stories often showed huge groups of slaves working under cruel masters. However, archaeologists now tell a different story.
Near the pyramids, archaeologists found the remains of a town where workers lived. They also found bakeries and many animal bones. This suggests that the workers ate bread and meat.

Workers who died were buried in small tombs near the pyramids. Many archaeologists now think that the workers were respected, not treated as slaves. Many experts now think the builders were paid Egyptian workers. Some were skilled builders, and others worked in rotating teams. Together, they worked in large organised teams.
